facts.fact: Police Minister Senzo Mchunu announced on 11 April 2025, after the Policing Summit in Ekurhuleni, that SAPS had established a partnership with the private sector to digitise case dockets and to upgrade five police stations across Gauteng, KwaZulu-Natal, Limpopo and the Western Cape; the document gives no count of stations digitising dockets.
